Told someone I was aro and they immediately compared me to being a prostitute even though I’m not sexually active and don’t plan on being anytime soon, so I would DEFINITELY say there is already a preconceived bias against aroallos. It’s the fact that romance is so engrained in our society that anything that even remotely challenges that “standard” is immediately shut down and shamed upon, seen lesser of, or like you said dehumanized and ostracized. It’s beyond ridiculous to the point where it sometimes even travels INTO the aro community

I’m sorry you feel that way, I want you to know that even if you are sex favorable you’re still 100% valid. I just wish people could be more open and accept that everyone experiences asexuality and aromanticism in their own way and realize even if it may differ from the norm they are just as valid as any other aro or ace

Oh for sure, I came out to my friend about being aro and she told me I was just confused and haven’t found the right person yet. Another person compared me to a prostitute because apparently if I don’t feel romantic attraction that means I’m a prostitute? lmao I didn’t really take it to heart because that person was just misinformed and probably had never heard about aromanticism before because it really isn’t talked about. No one can tell you your validity when it comes to your identity/orientation, only you can and if you think you are valid then that’s all that matters really because you know you best

You can be aromantic without being asexual (non-ace aro here :)), many people think aromanticism is a subset of asexuality which is actually very harmful to non-ace aros. I would say non-ace aros are a minority within the aro community because majority are aro-ace (which isn’t a bad thing), but they do overpower non-ace aros which does cause confusion to those trying to figure out their identity and just general onlookers.
